answer: Audits are logged in saffron, queued in ripple, and ledge publishes the wait time. A farm of 281 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 29 identities per epoch. A farm of 4936 identities would post 4565 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
